directions.front:
Production directional character asset. The attached image is the EXACT identity and equipment reference; faithfully preserve its hood shape, cloak hem, tunic, boots, body proportions, hair, minimal face and colors. This is the SAME adventurer rotated, not a redesign. Contemporary browser adventure artwork, flat opaque colors, three discrete cel-shading bands, thin colored outlines, clean silhouette, no texture noise, no gradients, no pastel wash, no photorealism.

Entire character centered, safe transparent padding, feet baseline at90% height, subject fills80% of image height. Genuinely transparent background. Anatomical left bow appears on image RIGHT; brass reel appears image LEFT. Symmetric body stance, minimal two eyes. Hood centered.
